about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking Moderna, Inc. on trade[XYZ]. Users get linear exposure to MRNA share-price moves without owning MRNA shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. HIP-3 builder-deployed market on Hyperliquid in the xyz namespace, cash-settled in USDC, isolated margin only, 10x max leverage. Hyperliquid API on 2026-08-19 reported 30,789.24 base open interest at a $148.18 mark (~$4.56M notional) and $33.63M 24h notional volume.
